batchrate.retention_note: Input files deleted 7 days after the batch ends; output files after 30 days (can be shortened to 1 hour).

engy.retention_note: Gateway stores no request content. End-to-end ZDR requires the ZDR flag — unflagged requests may reach a worker run by an independent operator. Integrity audits (qwen3.6-35b-a3b only) keep response token IDs up to 30 days.

openscale.retention_note: Chat Completions and Messages are never stored. Responses API stores responses for 30 days unless store:false or account ZDR is enabled; that is not the calculator default path.

sarvam.pricing_note: Billed in INR. USD prices are converted at ₹1 = $0.010762 (ECB reference rate of 2026-11-23), refreshed weekly; your actual charge follows the rupee rate when you pay.

inco.retention_note: Content logs are kept only while the opt-out "Store & Improve" setting is on: deleted within 30 days for European accounts, otherwise kept as long as needed to improve the service (reviewed yearly) and deleted within 30 days of turning the setting off. With it off, bodies are not retained beyond the request. The three standard-tier GLM 5.3 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash ids are relayed to Z.ai (Singapore) and DeepSeek (PRC) under their own terms; every `:fast` id and both MiniMax/Kimi ids run on Inco infrastructure.

jarvislabs.retention_note: Token Factory states it does not store prompts or completions and does not train on them (product page and FAQ); the Terms of Service do not address inference content and reserve the right to retain "all information provided for as long as the information is needed". Cached input bills automatically with no cache-write fee.

open scale.retention_note: Chat Completions and Messages are never stored. Responses API stores responses for 30 days unless store:false or account ZDR is enabled; that is not the calculator default path.
